title: CMD-013-mobile-route-screenshot-review
universal_lens: The mobile route verification process is modeled as a projection operator mapping the high-dimensional latent state space of the shipping clone onto a lower-dimensional observable evidence manifold. This ensures that the realized product topology strictly satisfies the boundary conditions defined by prior research primitives.
gsi_mapping: GSI treats screenshot capture as a conformal prediction sequence, where each verified UI state acts as a calibration point. The system computes nonconformity scores against expected rendering baselines, establishing rigorous confidence intervals for launch readiness and minimizing epistemic uncertainty in user-facing components.
gse_mapping: Within GSE, this primitive functions as a discrete state-transition gate. primitives.name: Mobile Route Evidence Projection
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## Department Owner Primary: Executive / Founder Command Supporting: QA / Testing / Release; Operations / Founder Cockpit Worker/agent: mobile/accessibility ## Goal Capture and review mobile screenshots for all launch routes.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: R: Set of application routes (dimensionless); S: Screenshot evidence vector (pixel array); P: Projection operator.
primitives.assumptions: Assumes the underlying DOM structure deterministically maps to visual outputs across standard mobile viewports.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Singularities occur when dynamic client-side hydration fails or viewport-dependent CSS media queries yield non-deterministic layouts.

layer2.mapping: Isomorphic to GSE trajectory validation; verifying discrete spatial states along a predefined navigational path.
layer2.telemetry: Visual diff delta against baseline renders; route traversal success rate.

primitives.name: Repository State Audit Operator
primitives.verbatim_quote: Verify real repo root, branch, dirty state, package manager, app routes, and relevant files.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: V: Git versioning graph; B: Current branch pointer; D: Dirty state boolean; F: File system hash map.
primitives.assumptions: Assumes the local file system accurately reflects the intended deployment artifact and git history is uncorrupted.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Fails under severe repository corruption, conflicting merge states, or missing dependency lockfiles.

layer2.mapping: Maps to GSI pre-inference data integrity checks, ensuring the input tensor (codebase) is clean before model execution.
layer2.telemetry: Git status output, dependency resolution time, route file existence flags.

primitives.name: Empirical Evidence Manifestation
primitives.verbatim_quote: Capture evidence: command output, screenshots if UI, source links if data.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: E: Evidence set; C: Command output string; L: Source link URI.
primitives.assumptions: Assumes observables can be faithfully recorded and stored without lossy compression altering their semantic meaning.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Breaks down if logging mechanisms are disabled or if transient UI states cannot be captured synchronously.

layer2.mapping: Directly isomorphic to GSI telemetry ingestion, converting raw system events into structured, queryable evidence vectors.
layer2.telemetry: Artifact storage volume, log parsing success rate, screenshot checksums.

reasoning_traces.cross_layer_veto: Anti-collinearity is enforced by strictly separating the verification layer from the mutation layer. The veto condition triggers if any attempt is made to deploy, alter the production database, or expose proprietary methodology during the screenshot capture process. Leakage occurs if the evidence generation inadvertently triggers live affiliate links or sends real telemetry to external analytics endpoints, contaminating the clean test environment. To prevent this, the operator must run in a fully isolated sandbox, mocking all external API calls and network requests. Any deviation from this read-only constraint results in an immediate abort, preserving the epistemic purity of the verification trace and ensuring that the observed states are solely a function of the local codebase.
